summary: The complete official isolated repository suite passes 1370 tests on the final T32 product bytes without production KB writes.
facts: A clean full clone ran 1370 tests in 301.396 seconds and exited zero with six disclosed platform skips.
The run used an empty production KB sentinel and the official isolation runner reported no production-write violation.
The later c7fd29a commit only removes a repository-only duplicate test assertion; all staged and installed product bytes are identical to the full-suite candidate.
